displayPattern: 7-segment display on an American Standard S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace: E2.2
meaning: Recycles exceeded: flame was sensed and then lost. One-hour lockout after 10 times.
causes: Flame sensed, then lost, until the recycle limit is exceeded
diySteps: E2.2 is not E2.1. E2.1 is flame never sensed. E2.2 is flame that proved and then went away
Technician: the heating sequence in this guide proves flame at the flame sensor within 4 seconds, typically 0.75 to 3.0 microamps
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if the burners light and then drop out until E2.2 locks out for an hour.
